authoring: Dinner items are read from the planner week and the cookbook. Each week below only sets the household amounts, adds breakfast, lunch, snack, and kid items, and hides what should not be bought. No nutrition figures. Standing extras, added to every week and listed in regulars so a new week picks them up: shredded mild cheddar (not sharp), Ratio yogurt cups in a quantity of 8, Starbucks refrigerated unsweetened coffee (1), and coffee creamer (1) in dairy.
